queue.title: Engagement probe: detect Firebase/Firestore write patterns
queue.description: (added ~s713): Similar to Supabase RPC/edge fn detection, Firebase SPAs use `addDoc()`, `setDoc()`, `updateDoc()`, and callable Cloud Functions (`httpsCallable`). Adding these patterns would catch Firebase-backed write-capable SPAs that the current probe misses.
